Light Leak Effect

Add warm analog light-leak overlays to your photos — pick the leak position, color mood and intensity.

Leaks are layered gradients blended in screen mode, like real film leaks. Processed locally in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a photo.
  2. Pick a leak position (or Random for a surprise).
  3. Choose a color mood and drag the intensity slider.
  4. Click "Download image" to save the PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What light-leak styles are there?

Warm amber, sunset rose, golden hour and rainbow streaks — each built from layered radial gradients blended in screen mode like real light leaks.

Can I move the leak?

Pick a corner or edge, or choose Random and hit it again for a new leak each time.

Is my photo uploaded?

Yes — your photo never leaves your browser.
